name: znetwork_dplay_report_error
description: zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError returns success for zero HRESULT and reports recognized DirectPlay failures as a legacy zError message.
known_limits: The smoke covers the zero-HRESULT success path and one recognized DirectPlay failure path; full string-table coverage and tier S verification are deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48c250 validates zero HRESULT returns 1 and nonzero DirectPlay errors are decoded and reported through zError::ReportOldNoOp.
The native smoke verifies zero HRESULT returns success and a representative DirectPlay error returns failure after report handling.
